svg.title: Full flow with only two tools: search_tool and run_tool
svg.desc: The user's prompt reaches the LLM via Claude Code. The LLM makes a single call to search_tool to get the right tools, writes a workflow, and makes a single call to run_tool, which runs several internal calls in a sandbox and returns a consolidated result. The LLM analyzes it and replies to the user.
svg.text: I want to buy a light-up keyboard
and ship it to my house
It's on its way to your home.
